patch_description: Proposed improvement: unify parameter sharing within the ANSATZ_SPEC by (i) sharing the center rotation angle across pre- and post-entanglement layers using a single rz_center key, and (ii) sharing the hub-to-center angle across all hub-edge connections using a single hub_angle key for both CRZ (center-to-edge) and CRX (center-to-edge) gates. This reduces per-block parameter count and enforces symmetry-inspired sharing, while keeping the same data encoding, re-uploading, and measurement structure. All edits are contained within the EVOLVE-BLOCK (ANSATZ_SPEC) and preserve the fixed training loop and data pipeline.
